subject: general
question: The change in demand for a good or service caused by a change in a consumer's purchasing power resulting from a change in real income is called ______.
solution:
The correct answer is __**income effect**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The change in demand for a commodity or service brought on by a shift in a consumer's purchasing power as a result of a change in real income is known as** the income effect in microeconomics.**
 
• This adjustment may be brought about by an increase in salaries, for example, or by the release of funds from an existing income due to a drop in the cost of the item being purchased.
 
• The income effect is an expression of how changes in relative market prices and incomes impact consumption patterns for consumer goods and services.
 
• **Consumer choice theory **links preferences to consumption expenditures and consumer demand curves.
 
• When real consumer income increases, consumers will desire more of the typical economic items to buy.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **The substitution effect **is the decline in sales of a product that results from customers switching to less expensive substitutes when the price of the product increases.
 
• The change in output that results from using one extra unit of a certain input, given that the quantities of other inputs are held constant, is known as the **marginal product **or **marginal physical productivity of an input (factor of production).**
 
• The set of all conceivable consumption bundles that a customer may afford, given the prices of the commodities they have access to and their income, is known in economics as a** budget set or the opportunity set facing a consumer. **
